summary: On effect entities that carry a sound; read by ls::SoundOcclusionSystem (macOS name, view with ls::EffectComponent, ParentEntityComponent). One 8-byte member, an entity handle.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: macOS default constructor stores 0xFFC0000000000000 (the null EntityHandle) to +0; registration bg3.exe+0x3B4F130: size 8, no destructor; live: 48 different handles with the usual handle high bits (0x01400001 / 0x01C00002). Probably the sound entity attached to the effect (name from the component's name).

open_questions: Which entity it points to (the sound object entity or the owner) was not proven from a reader.
